questions.q: How many active relationships can exist between the same two tables at once?
options: Only one
As many as you create
Exactly two
Zero — all relationships must be inactive
questions.explain: Power BI allows only one active relationship between any two tables, so there's always an unambiguous default when visuals combine fields from both.

questions.q: What happens if the wrong relationship between two tables ends up active?
options: Reports can return technically correct but unintended numbers, based on the wrong default path
Power BI throws an error and won't load the report
Both relationships apply simultaneously
The inactive relationship is automatically deleted
questions.explain: The wrong active relationship isn't an error — it just filters by an unintended path, like showing who opened a ticket instead of who worked on it.

questions.q: How do you switch which relationship is active between two tables?
options: In Manage relationships, uncheck the currently active one and check the one you want instead
Delete the unwanted relationship entirely
Change the relationship's cardinality
Active relationships can't be changed once set
questions.explain: Manage relationships lists every relationship with an Active checkbox — checking one relationship between two tables automatically unchecks the other.

questions.q: What is an inactive relationship still useful for?
options: It can be activated for one specific calculation using the DAX USERELATIONSHIP function
Nothing — it has no effect until deleted
It automatically becomes active during data refresh
It only matters for Import mode, not DirectQuery
questions.explain: An inactive relationship stays available — a DAX measure can explicitly activate it for a single calculation using USERELATIONSHIP, without changing the model's default.

questions.q: What modeling pattern commonly relies on one active relationship plus several inactive ones?
options: Role-playing dimensions, like a single Date table connected to a fact table by order date, ship date, and delivery date
Snowflake dimensions
Junk dimensions
Factless fact tables
questions.explain: A role-playing dimension reuses one table for multiple roles — only one relationship is active by default, with measures using USERELATIONSHIP to reach the others.
